summary: Added pure speech settings parsing with validated defaults and restricted fields.

summary: Added per-user speech settings file loader with BOM handling and explicit failure results.
intent: Keep missing settings disabled by default while separating read, JSON and validation failures.

summary: Add explicit development configuration bootstrap and shared path-derived credential identity; verify build and 23 assertions.
intent: Isolate development configuration from normal user state while reusing the same CLI.

summary: Add validated settings writer using write-file-atomic and safe failure results.

summary: Use nova by default and support optional bounded free-text tone with explicit reset.
intent: Let users customize speaking style without required preset selection.

intent: Allow switching providers without losing existing preferences.

summary: Expose a preferred buffered or streaming playback mode in speech configuration.
intent: Keep playback preferences separate from ephemeral delivery and credentials.

summary: Add compatible playbackVolume defaults, bounded configuration, and persistence across providers.
intent: Apply user feedback after successful cross-session speech playback.

summary: Persist the selected Gemini TTS model and catalog voice in the provider profile.
